name: Espinosa de Cerrato (Spain)
description: Square flag of five horizontal stripes of white, blue, white, blue and white, the white stripes charged with seven red crosses.
history: Municipal flag of Espinosa de Cerrato; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: seven crosses on the white stripes, two above, three in the centre and two below
